kael.t: When defending, you may change 1 of your focus results to an evade result.

brink.t: Other friendly ships at range 1 cannot be attacked if the attacker could attack you instead.

knife.t: When attacking at range 1, roll 1 additional attack die.

hex.t: When defending, ships attacking you cannot spend focus tokens or reroll attack dice.

nightjar.t: After you fly a green maneuver, you may take a free focus action.

wren.t: When attacking, reduce the defender's agility by 1 (minimum 0).

garrick.t: After you spend a focus token, you may pass it to another friendly ship at range 1-2 instead of discarding it.

brannoc.t: After you acquire a target lock, choose another friendly ship at range 1-2: it may acquire a target lock at once.

horace.t: When attacking at range 2-3, you may reroll any of your blank results.

gutter.t: When attacking at range 1, you may change 1 of your hit results to a crit.

shiv.t: When attacking from outside the defender's firing arc, roll 1 additional attack die.

wailer.t: When another friendly ship at range 1 attacks with its primary weapon, it may reroll 1 attack die.

varn.t: When your attack deals a faceup damage card, draw 3 instead, deal the one you choose and discard the others.

castigan.t: During your action step you may take 2 actions.

tamsin.t: You may take actions even while you have stress tokens.

arlo.t: You may attack an enemy ship in your firing arc that you are touching.

grudge.t: When your damage reaches your hull, you are not destroyed until the end of the combat phase.

tarn.t: After you attack, you may take a free boost or barrel roll action.

sorin.t: When you receive a stress token, you may also take a focus token.

grawl.t: When you are dealt a faceup damage card, flip it facedown at once without resolving it.

lark.t: After you fly a green maneuver, another friendly ship at range 1 may take 1 free action from its action bar.

jax.t: When attacking, you may reroll all of your dice (if you do, you must reroll as many as possible).

kira.t: When attacking, the defender receives 1 stress token if it cancels at least 1 crit.

bram.t: When you reveal a bank maneuver, you may switch to the other bank of the same speed.

krell.t: When attacking with a secondary weapon, you may reroll 1 attack die.

oren.t: When attacking, 1 of your crit results cannot be cancelled by defense dice.

iveth.t: When attacking or defending with at least 1 stress token, you may reroll 1 of your dice.

quill.t: At the start of combat, choose another friendly ship at range 1-3: it counts as pilot skill 12 until the phase ends.

kellan.t: At the start of combat, you may pass 1 of your focus tokens to another friendly ship at range 1-3.

juno.t: When another friendly ship at range 1-3 attacks, if you have no stress, you may take 1 to give it 1 extra attack die.

joren.t: When another friendly ship at range 1 attacks with a secondary weapon, it may reroll up to 2 attack dice.

rhane.t: When attacking with a secondary weapon, you may stretch its range by 1 (within range 1-3).

kade.t: When an enemy ship acquires a target lock, it must lock onto you if it can.

varek.t: At the start of combat, you may hand your target lock to a friendly ship at range 1 that has none.

orrin.t: When another friendly ship at range 1-2 would receive a stress token, if you have 2 or fewer, you may take it instead.

u_plasma.t: Attack (target lock): spend your lock and discard this card. Attack 4, range 2-3. You may change 1 focus result to a crit.

u_tinker.t: After you fly a green maneuver, recover 1 shield (up to your shield value).

u_juke.t: Action: increase your agility by 1 until the end of the round.

u_will.t: When you are dealt a faceup damage card with the Pilot trait, discard it at once without resolving it.

u_dead.t: Action: when attacking this round, you may change 1 focus result to a crit and all other focus results to hits.

u_ionturret.t: Attack 3, range 1-2, any direction. On a hit the target suffers 1 damage and gets an ion token; then cancel all dice.

u_assist.t: All your speed 1 and 2 maneuvers count as green.

u_patch.t: Action: roll 1 defense die. On an evade or focus, discard 1 of your facedown damage cards.

u_relock.t: After you spend a target lock, roll 1 defense die: on an evade, lock the same ship again (not usable in this attack).

u_scrap.t: In the end phase, you may flip 1 of your faceup Ship-trait damage cards facedown.

u_pack.t: At the start of combat, you may choose 1 friendly ship at range 1: it counts as having your pilot skill until the phase ends.

u_lead.t: Action: choose 1 friendly ship at range 1-2 with lower pilot skill: it may take 1 free action at once.

u_snap.t: Action: a free barrel roll (take a stress token if barrel roll is not on your action bar); then remove 1 enemy lock from you.

u_shock.t: Attack (target lock): spend your lock and discard this card. Attack 4, range 2-3. You may change 1 blank result to a hit.

u_swarmm.t: Attack (target lock): spend your lock and discard this card. Attack 3, range 1-2, twice.

u_hairpin.t: Action: fly a white turn 1 left or right, then take a stress token. Without boost on your action bar, also roll 2 attack dice and suffer any hits.

u_slip.t: When defending, if you have no stress, you may take 1 stress token to choose 1 attack die: the attacker must reroll it.

u_seeker.t: Attack (target lock): discard this card (keep the lock). Attack 4, range 2-3. The defender cannot spend evade tokens.

u_redline.t: Once per round, after an action you may take 1 free action from your action bar, then take a stress token.

u_snapeye.t: Weapons that need a target lock can use focus instead: spend a focus token where you would spend a lock.

u_allin.t: Action: until the end of the round, +1 primary weapon value and -1 agility.

u_tailgun.t: After an attack that does not hit, you may at once make a primary weapon attack (against any legal target). You cannot attack again this round.

u_ionlance.t: Attack 3, range 1-3. On a hit the defender suffers 1 damage and gets an ion token; then cancel all dice.

u_beam.t: Attack 4, range 2-3. Right after rolling, all your crits become hits.

u_quake.t: When you reveal your dial, you may discard this card to drop a quake charge. It detonates at the end of the Activation phase: every ship at range 1 suffers 1 damage.

u_hired.t: When attacking at range 3, you may change 1 hit result to a crit.

u_burst.t: Attack (target lock): spend your lock and discard this card. Attack 4, range 2-3. On a hit, every other ship at range 1 of the defender suffers 1 damage.

u_mines.t: Action: discard this card to drop a contact mine. When a ship's base or template overlaps it, it detonates: that ship rolls 3 attack dice and suffers every hit and crit.

u_fct.t: You may keep 2 target locks (only 1 per enemy ship). When you acquire a target lock, you may lock onto 2 different ships.

u_heat.t: When a friendly ship at range 1 is hit, you may suffer 1 of its uncancelled crits instead.

u_rook.t: After an attack that does not hit, you may at once make a primary weapon attack, and in it you may change 1 focus to a hit. You cannot attack again this round.

u_nib.t: All your straight maneuvers count as green.

u_brakk.t: When you are dealt a damage card, you may discard it and recover 1 shield; then discard Brakk.

u_hplasma.t: Attack (target lock): spend your lock and discard this card. Attack 5, range 1. You may change up to 3 blank results to focus.

u_rapid.t: Attack 3, range 1. Your hits cannot be cancelled by defense dice (the defender may cancel crits first).

u_track.t: After you attack, you may acquire a target lock on the defender.

u_twin.t: Attack (focus): spend 1 focus token. Attack 3, range 1-2, any direction.

u_scout.t: When you take a focus action, take 1 extra focus token.

u_sab.t: Action: pick an enemy at range 1 and roll 1 attack die. On a hit or crit, flip one of its random facedown damage cards faceup and resolve it.

u_spot.t: At the start of the Activation phase, choose 1 enemy ship at range 1-2: you may look at its chosen maneuver.

u_pbomb.t: When you reveal your dial, you may discard this card to drop a plasma bomb. It detonates at the end of the Activation phase: every ship at range 1 is dealt 1 faceup damage card, straight past its shields.

u_adren.t: When you reveal a red maneuver, you may discard this card to treat it as white this activation.

u_early.t: Just before you reveal your maneuver, you may take 1 free action; if you do, skip your action step this round.

u_jam.t: When defending, you may change 1 of the attacker's hits into a focus. The attacker cannot reroll that die.

u_vell.t: After you attack an enemy ship, you may suffer 2 damage to deal it 1 critical damage.

u_captive.t: Once per round, the first ship to declare you as a target receives 1 stress token.

u_instr.t: When defending, you may reroll 1 focus result; against an attacker with pilot skill 2 or lower, you may reroll 1 blank instead.

u_nav.t: When you reveal a maneuver, you may switch to another maneuver with the same bearing (no red while stressed).

t_warden.t: Your upgrade bar gains a torpedo slot.

t_kite.t: In the end phase, do not remove your unused focus tokens.

t_writ.t: When you acquire a target lock, you may lock any enemy ship on the battlefield.

m_stealth.t: +1 agility. If an attack hits you, discard this card.

m_apl.t: After an enemy maneuver makes it overlap you, roll 1 attack die: on a hit or crit, that ship suffers 1 damage.

rupture.t: This card counts as 2 damage against your hull.

flash.t: The next time you attack, roll no attack dice. Then flip this card facedown.

cfire.t: At the start of each combat phase, roll 1 attack die: on a hit, suffer 1 damage. Action: flip this card facedown.

canopy.t: After the round you receive this card, your pilot skill counts as 0.

stutter.t: All your turn maneuvers count as red maneuvers.

blackout.t: You cannot take the actions on your action bar. Action: roll 1 attack die; on a hit, flip this card facedown.

wound.t: Ignore your pilot ability and your Talent upgrades.

blast.t: Roll 1 attack die at once: on a hit, suffer 1 damage. Then flip this card facedown.

breach.t: After you fly a red maneuver, roll 1 attack die: on a hit, suffer 1 damage.

jam.t: Discard 1 of your secondary weapon upgrades at once. Then flip this card facedown.

frame.t: Reduce your agility by 1 (minimum 0). Action: roll 1 attack die; on a hit, flip this card facedown.

concuss.t: After a maneuver that makes you overlap a ship or an obstacle, suffer 1 damage.

flare.t: Receive 1 stress token at once. Then flip this card facedown.

glitch.t: Reduce your primary weapon value by 1 (minimum 0). Action: roll 1 attack die; on a hit or crit, flip this card facedown.

EXPS.d: Anvil bomber, Talon Prime, more Lancer & Talon pilots; turrets, ion, missiles.
Needle, Razor, the Longhaul freighter and the Warden gunship; bombs, crew, turrets, rear arcs.
Keel strike fighter, Kestrel courier, Talon Maul bomber, Herald shuttle; systems, mines.
